tables: club_booking_barcategory

CREATE TABLE "club_booking_barcategory" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" text NOT NULL, "order_priority" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("order_priority" >= 0))
club_booking_baritem

CREATE TABLE "club_booking_baritem" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" varchar(120) NOT NULL, "portion_size" varchar(50) NOT NULL, "price" decimal NOT NULL, "is_available" bool NOT NULL, "category_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "club_booking_barcategory" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "bar_item_price_non_negative" CHECK ("price" >= '0'))
club_booking_booking

CREATE TABLE "club_booking_booking" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "booking_number" varchar(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "booking_date" date NOT NULL, "time_start" time NOT NULL, "time_end" time NOT NULL, "duration_hours" decimal NOT NULL, "players_count" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("players_count" >= 0), "rental_cost" decimal NOT NULL, "discount_amount" decimal NOT NULL, "total_cost" decimal NOT NULL, "deposit_amount" decimal NOT NULL, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "notes" text NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "client_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "club_booking_client" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "resource_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "club_booking_clubresource" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "booking_time_valid" CHECK ("time_end" > ("time_start")), CONSTRAINT "booking_players_positive" CHECK ("players_count" > 0), CONSTRAINT "booking_total_cost_non_negative" CHECK ("total_cost" >= '0'), CONSTRAINT "unique_resource_time_slot" UNIQUE ("resource_id", "booking_date", "time_start"))
club_booking_bookingbarorder

CREATE TABLE "club_booking_bookingbarorder" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "quantity" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("quantity" >= 0), "price_at_order" decimal NOT NULL, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "ordered_at" datetime NOT NULL, "bar_item_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "club_booking_baritem" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "booking_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "club_booking_booking" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "bar_order_quantity_positive" CHECK ("quantity" > 0))
club_booking_client

CREATE TABLE "club_booking_client" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "last_name" varchar(50) NOT NULL, "first_name" varchar(50) NOT NULL, "patronymic" varchar(50) NULL, "phone" varchar(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "email" varchar(254) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "bonus_balance" decimal NOT NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "client_bonus_non_negative" CHECK ("bonus_balance" >= '0'))
club_booking_clubcard

CREATE TABLE "club_booking_clubcard" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "card_number" varchar(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "card_tier" varchar(15) NOT NULL, "discount_percent" decimal NOT NULL, "issued_at" date NOT NULL, "expires_at" date NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "client_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "club_booking_client" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "card_discount_range" CHECK (("discount_percent" >= '0' AND "discount_percent" <= '100')))
club_booking_clubresource

CREATE TABLE "club_booking_clubresource" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "resource_number" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("resource_number" >= 0), "title" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "equipment_brand" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "max_capacity" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("max_capacity" >= 0), "category_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "club_booking_resourcecategory" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_resource_number_per_category" UNIQUE ("category_id", "resource_number"))
club_booking_payment

CREATE TABLE "club_booking_payment" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "transaction_id" varchar(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "payment_type" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "payment_method" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "amount" decimal NOT NULL, "fiscal_receipt_number" varchar(50) NULL, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "booking_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "club_booking_booking" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "payment_amount_positive" CHECK ("amount" > '0'))
club_booking_resourcecategory

CREATE TABLE "club_booking_resourcecategory" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" varchar(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "min_players" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("min_players" >= 0), "max_players" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("max_players" >= 0), CONSTRAINT "category_players_min_max_valid" CHECK ("max_players" >= ("min_players")))
club_booking_tariff

CREATE TABLE "club_booking_tariff" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "day_type" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "time_slot" varchar(10) NOT NULL, "price_per_hour" decimal NOT NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "category_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "club_booking_resourcecategory" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CONSTRAINT "unique_tariff_per_slot" UNIQUE ("category_id", "day_type", "time_slot"), CONSTRAINT "tariff_price_positive" CHECK ("price_per_hour" > '0'))
